sources.snippet: mnma Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 (Minima) A fully W4A4 build of Qwen3.8-27B by post-training quantization alone: every one of the 496 backbone linear layers — all 48 Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers and their gate projections included — quantized to NVFP4, plus calibrated FP8 KV-cache scales. No quantization-aware training, no distillation — calibration only. Early public 4-bit builds of this model ...

sources.title: Minima Paper Fully Quantizes Qwen3.8-27B to NVFP4 W4A4 Including Gated ...
sources.snippet: EmailSubscribeAlso get breaking AI alerts Summary The Minima paper quantizes all 496 linear layers of Qwen3.8-27B — including the 48 Gated DeltaNet blocks every prior recipe kept at FP8/BF16 — to NVFP4 W4A4, and matches BF16 within seed noise on MMLU-Pro, GSM8K, AIME'25, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench, and RULER at 64K.
